title: Ground the next action
description: Choose a task, observation bundle, and action horizon. The workspace reveals whether the target is identified strongly enough to act and when the plan becomes stale.

channels.label: Pixels
channels.detail: Rendered position, overlays, canvas content, and visual state.

channels.label: Semantics
channels.detail: Role, accessible name, value, focus, and control state.

channels.label: Programmatic state
channels.detail: Origin, URL, record identifiers, and authoritative application state.

scenes.label: Invoice filter
scenes.task: Filter the invoice table to Overdue without changing data.
scenes.expectedPostcondition: The Status filter reads Overdue and every visible row is overdue.

scenes.label: Checkout review
scenes.task: Open the final order review without placing the order.
scenes.surface: Volatile checkout with a promotional overlay
scenes.expectedPostcondition: A review panel opens; no order ID or charge exists.

scenes.label: Canvas export
scenes.task: Open the export menu for the currently selected diagram.

target.label: Export icon
target.locator: visual target at the top-right toolbar

scenes.expectedPostcondition: The export menu is visible and the selected diagram is unchanged.

observations.label: Screenshot only
observations.detail: Fresh pixels show layout and overlays but provide no semantic target contract.

observations.label: Semantic tree only
observations.detail: Roles, names, focus, and values produce precise targets but can miss canvas and overlays.

observations.label: Hybrid observation
observations.detail: Align fresh pixels with roles, names, origin, and application state.

plans.label: One action, then verify
plans.detail: Resolve one target, execute once, and capture a new observation.

plans.label: Three-action macro
plans.detail: Click, fill, and continue before checking whether the interface changed.

plans.label: Use an application contract
plans.detail: Prefer a structured read or write path when the application exposes one.
